Everything you need to know to get started
What is Ergo in one sentence?
Ergo is a secure, open-source PoW blockchain for programmable, censorship-resistant money using the eUTXO model.
How do I get started (wallet + first transaction)?
Install a supported wallet, back up your seed offline, get ERG (DEX/exchange/faucet), then send your first test transaction.
How much are network fees and who gets them?
Typical fees are ≈ $0.01 and go to miners for processing blocks; the exact fee is shown before you confirm. Fees vary with network load.
Why is Ergo a strong fit for autonomous work settlement?

Ergo's eUTXO model gives deterministic costs, ErgoScript can encode task acceptance rules, Babel Fees reduce native-token bootstrapping, and receipt workflows can connect payment, verification and settlement. Current agent-economy demos stay testnet-first until audit gates open.
Ergo is secured by the Autolykos Proof-of-Work algorithm, open code, and community audits. Users should keep seed phrases offline, verify downloads/URLs, and prefer hardware wallets.
What risks should I know before using Ergo?
Self-custody means irreversible transactions; markets are volatile; third-party dApps carry smart-contract and operational risk; watch for phishing.
A PoW/eUTXO stack where programmable credit, acceptance predicates, wallet policy, receipts, and settlement can be modeled as inspectable economic obligations.
The eUTXO model helps agents reason about cost and state before submitting. Transactions execute against explicit boxes and predicates, with no hidden global state.
Agents never overpay or fail unexpectedly
ErgoScript embeds acceptance conditions directly in payments. No escrow service, no oracle, no trusted server. The payment itself encodes what must be true for redemption.
Babel Fees let agents cover transaction fees through supported token-to-ERG paths. Spin up a new agent, hand it a Note, and reduce the native-gas bootstrapping step.
Ephemeral agents work out of the box
Proof-of-Work consensus with no foundation multisig, no validator cartel, no emergency pause. No committee can freeze agent funds or halt the network. Unstoppable by design.
